image_description: A blue and white electric steam iron with a silver metallic soleplate, positioned against a plain white background. The iron features a red temperature dial on the top handle, a brown textured grip at the rear of the handle, and a visible power cord entry point. There is faint, semi-transparent text watermarking across the middle of the image.

The red dial lacks clear numerical markings or distinct ridges expected on a functional control knob; it appears slightly melted or overly smooth compared to the rest of the plastic.
